verdict.conclusion: Ranking the Delta Pro DIY product page for 'retractable roof system melbourne' is unrealistic. The SERP rewards supply-and-install companies with local trust signals and quote funnels. Skyflex sells a $5,200-$7,800 DIY SKU with an add-to-cart — a fundamentally different page type from everything Google ranks here.
verdict.no_local_pack_caveat: Unlike the sibling keyword ('retractable awning melbourne'), this SERP has NO local pack. That removes one barrier but does not change the page-type mismatch: the organic results themselves are installers.
